description: Change a picture to JPEG, PNG or WebP: an iPhone HEIC photo to JPG, a PNG to WebP, a TIFF or BMP to PNG. Free, with a daily limit per account. Give the file through get_upload_link (file_id) or a public link. The result link works for 24 hours; give it to the user exactly as returned.

file_id.description: The file_id from get_upload_link, once the user has uploaded the picture (JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC, GIF, BMP or TIFF) there.

file_url.description: Or a public https link to the picture (JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC, GIF, BMP or TIFF). A result link from another YangOpen tool works too.

name: convert_image
title: Convert a picture (HEIC to JPG and more)
